channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: ECB’s Cipollone urged colleagues to hold off on further hikes until new economic projections land
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Executive Board member Piero Cipollone on Wednesday urged colleagues to hold off on any further rate hikes until new economic projections land.

item.title: ECB's Demarco: Central bank can delay decision on additional tightening until next projections
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member and Governor of the Central Bank of Malta, Alexander Demarco, said on Wednesday that the central bank can delay decisions on additional tightening until next projections.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Slides below 1.3250 after failing to break through 23.6% Fibo.
item.description: The GBP/USD pair meets with a fresh supply during the Asian session on Wednesday and moves away from a nearly two-week high around the 1.3275 region, touched the previous day.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Softens below 112.50, bias turns mildly bearish
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 112.20 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens against the Australian Dollar (AUD) as traders are on alert for possible intervention from Japanese authorities.

item.title: Gold hangs near YTD low, below $4,000 as Iran risks and Fed hike bets bolster USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts fresh sellers following the previous day's good two-way price swings and slides back below the $4,000 psychological mark during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Eyes 186.00 amid constructive bullish bias
item.description: EUR/JPY moves little after four days of gains, trading around 185.70 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD declines below $58 amid uncertainty over US-Iran peace prospects
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades almost 1% lower, slightly below $58.00, during the Asian trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar weakens as geopolitical uncertainty lifts US Dollar
item.description: USD/CAD has recovered its recent losses from the previous day, trading around 1.4220 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair appreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground on safe-haven demand amid uncertainty over United States (US)-Iran Doha talks.

item.title: WTI holds losses near $69.50 amid US-Iran Doha talks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price remains subdued for the second successive day, trading around $69.70 per barrel during the Asian hours on Wednesday. Crude oil prices decline as supply concerns ease amid potential peace talks in Doha between the US and Iran.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar holds losses to near 0.5650 following China PMI data
item.description: The NZD/USD pair holds negative ground near 0.5665 during the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) remains weak against the US Dollar (USD) following the Chinese economic data.

item.title: Australian Dollar remains depressed below 0.6900 vs firmer USD after China's PMI
item.description: The AUD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's goodish rebound from the 0.6865 region, or a three-month low, and meets with a fresh supply during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: China’s RatingDog Manufacturing PMI matches forecast in June: What 51.7 means for Australian Dollar
item.description: China's RatingDog Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) eased to 51.7 in June from 51.8 in May the latest data published by RatingDog showed on Wednesday. The market forecast was for a 51.7 reading.

item.title: Japanese Yen sinks to fresh low since 1986 vs USD amid persistently wide US-Japan rate gap
item.description: The USD/JPY pair builds on the previous day's breakout momentum and continues to scale new multi-decade highs through the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8067 vs. 6.8109 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.8067 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.8109 and 6.7795 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Euro declines to near 1.1400 as softer German inflation undercuts ECB hike bets
item.description: The EUR/USD pair loses momentum to near 1.1410 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday, pressured by receding bets for aggressive tightening by the European Central Bank (ECB).

item.title: British Pound weakens below 1.3250 on UK political risks, BoE repricing
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades in negative territory around 1.3245 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. Traders await the UK political developments, focusing on potential leadership by Andy Burnham and adherence to existing fiscal rules.

item.title: Japan’s Tankan Large Manufacturing Index rises to 22 in Q2 vs. 16 expected
item.description: The Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) Tankan survey of business sentiment surged significantly past market forecasts in the manufacturing sector. Japan’s Tankan Large Manufacturing Index climbed to 22 in the second quarter (Q2) from 17 in the previous reading, stronger than the market expectation of 16.

item.title: US President Donald Trump weighs all-out war on Iran but opts to stick with talks — WSJ
item.description: US President Donald Trump has held multiple conversations in recent days with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Gen.

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Upside risks as momentum fades against US Dollar – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Christopher Wong observes that USD/SGD has slipped, tracking broader USD moves as risk sentiment tentatively stabilised. Bullish momentum on the daily chart has faded and RSI has fallen, leaving risks skewed to the downside.

item.title: Asian FX: Scope for selective recovery on softer USD – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Christopher Wong suggests Asian FX may find a breather if USD momentum fades, with much Fed hawkishness and US data resilience already priced in. Contained Oil prices should ease external balance and inflation concerns for net Oil importers.

item.title: Gold flatlines near $4,000 as markets focus on US-Iran talks and upcoming employment data
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) trades on a flat note around $4,015 during the early Asian trading hours on Wednesday. Traders will closely monitor prospects for US-Iran talks in Doha after mixed messages from the US and Iran underscore the fragility of an interim peace deal reached earlier this month.

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Range-bound consolidation persists against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes that USD/SGD has lost upside momentum after briefly breaching support at 1.2925, shifting the short-term bias to neutral.

item.title: Euro stalls as Fed hike bets offset cooler Eurozone CPI
item.description: The Euro fails to gain traction versus the US Dollar on Tuesday, with the pair remaining steady at around 1.1400 as economic data on both sides of the Atlantic barely moved the needle. The EUR/USD trades at 1.1420.

item.title: China: PBoC overnight tool refines framework – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Michael Wan points to the People’s Bank of China’s new overnight liquidity tool, implicitly set at 1.25%, as a step in refining China’s interest rate framework.

item.title: Singapore: Growth profile raised – DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research economist Chua Han Teng upgrades Singapore’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP) outlook, noting that Singapore’s economy has remained resilient to renewed geopolitical shocks from the Middle East conflict.

item.title: Thai Baht: Recovery seen shallow without USD fade – OCBC
item.description: Christopher Wong at OCBC notes USD/THB’s recent rebound is running into interim resistance around 33.40 after a sharp move higher. Bank of Thailand officials attribute THB weakness mainly to broad USD strength and Thai equity outflows, while signalling readiness to manage excessive FX moves.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG trapped below $60 as bears eye $55
item.description: Silver price advances by over 1.50% on Tuesday, even as US Treasury yields rise and the US Dollar remains firm. Concerns about a fragile truce deal between the US and Iran keep the XAG/USD trading at $58.73, above its opening price.

item.title: Chinese Yuan: Range trade persists, downside risk intact against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang notes that USD/CNH remains confined to a tight range, with the Dollar expected to trade between 6.7940 and 6.8080 in the near term.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar neutral as Fed rate hike bets stay alive
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) traded on a neutral stance near the 101.20 level on Tuesday as investors digested mixed United States (US) data and hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) commentary.
